The intents are narrow, so unrelated history parents should continue using their existing paths.

skill.intent: Decide Entailment or Contradiction for a claim that a stated taxable income owes a stated amount under a specifically cited progressive-tax bracket.

outputs.description: Entailment only when the cited bracket applies to the stated income and its formula yields the claimed tax amount; otherwise Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

skill.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    income = float(inputs["taxable_income"])
    claimed = float(inputs["claimed_tax_amount"])
    lower = float(inputs["claimed_bracket_lower_exclusive"])
    upper = float(inputs["claimed_bracket_upper_inclusive"])
    base = float(inputs["claimed_bracket_base_tax"])
    rate = float(inputs["claimed_bracket_rate_percent"])
    applicable = income > lower
    if upper >= 0:
        applicable = applicable and income <= upper
    expected = base + rate * (income - lower) / 100
    answer = "Contradiction"
    if applicable and abs(expected - claimed) <= 0.01:
        answer = "Entailment"
    return {"answer": answer}
